description:
The research analytics team needs custom dimension tracking configured for the 'Research Platform' website to enable advanced audience segmentation and behavioral analysis.

Set up five custom dimensions for the Research Platform site:

Visit-scope dimensions (applied to the entire visit session):
1. 'Subscription Tier' — tracks whether the visitor is on a free, premium, or enterprise plan
2. 'User Cohort' — tracks A/B testing group assignments
3. 'Traffic Source Detail' — captures enriched acquisition source data beyond standard UTM parameters

Action-scope dimensions (applied to individual page views and events):
4. 'Page Category' — classifies content areas visited
5. 'Form Interaction' — tracks form-related events

All five custom dimensions must be set to active status.

Login credentials: admin / Admin12345
